latest_release.name: v1.400
latest_release.body: # v1.400 🚀 You know that one person who speaks SO MANY languages? And you're low-key jealous of them? That's Monaspace, now with expanded language support for Cyrillic, Greek, and Vietnamese! 👉 [Everything fixed in 1.4](https://github.com/githubnext/monaspace/milestone/4?closed=1) 👈 ## Font Packages - **Static Fonts** - Individual OTF files for each weight and style - **Variable Fonts** - Modern variable font files with adjustable weight/width - **Frozen Fonts** - TTF files with all stylistic sets "baked in" by default for editors which do not support stylistic sets - **NerdFonts** - Monaspace patched with [NerdFonts](https://www.nerdfonts.com/) glyphs - **Web NerdFonts** - WOFF/WOFF2 files with NerdFonts icons for web use - **Web Static** - WOFF/WOFF2 static font files optimized for web use - **Web Variable** - WOFF/WOFF2 variable font files optimized for web use ## Installation 1. Download the font package you need 2. Extract the zip file 3. Install the fonts on your system 4. Configure your editor/terminal to use Monaspace fonts See the [README](https://github.com/githubnext/monaspace#readme) for detailed installation instructions. # Enhancements * New support for Cyrillic, Greek, Vietnamese, and IPA character sets * New character variant sets: `cv12` enables Bulgarian-specific Cyrillic alternates, and `cv13` does the same for Serbian * ss06 now includes ligatures for `___`, `‗‗‗` and `====` (for equal sign, only applies to strings of 4 or more) # Visual tour ✌️❤️ GitHub Next
